# theme commands

Every `theme` command, with the arguments and options the console actually defines.

## `theme:resolve`

Resolve theme + skin for a (tenant, domain, locale) context — read-only diagnostic.

```bash
bin/semitexa theme:resolve
```

| option | takes a value |
|---|---|
| `--tenant` | yes |
| `--domain` | yes |
| `--locale` | yes |
| `--json` | no |

## `theme:scaffold`

Scaffold a project-local theme at src/theme/{slug}/ extending theme-base.

```bash
bin/semitexa theme:scaffold
```

| option | takes a value |
|---|---|
| `--slug` | yes |
| `--domain` | yes |
| `--force` | no |
| `--json` | no |

## `theme:validate`

Validate every theme.json manifest and report problems — exit code 1 on any error.

```bash
bin/semitexa theme:validate
```

| option | takes a value |
|---|---|
| `--json` | no |
